questions.question: A complete assembly data package should include:
options: Only the bare-board Gerbers with no BOM or placement file.
BOM, neutral database, XY placement, paste stencil artwork, and test-point file when DFT applies.
Only a photo of the stuffed prototype on a lab bench.
Only the schematic PDF without reference designators.
questions.explanation: BOM, neutral database file, XY placement file, solder paste stencil

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: After the PCB layout is complete and the data and documentation for the PCB has been generated, the fabrication package has most likely been released for fabrication.

questions.question: Before release, BOM information should be pulled from:
options: A spreadsheet someone edited from memory last year.
The source schematic.
The fab’s online star-rating page.
Random distributor cart screenshots.
questions.explanation: pull BOM information from the source schematic

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFPrior to release, always pull BOM information from the source schematic.

questions.question: The XY placement file must specify for each part:
options: Only the supplier’s DUNS number.
Reference designator, side, X/Y location, and orientation angle.
Only the color of the tape used on the reel.
Nothing if the EMS can guess from the silkscreen art.
questions.explanation: reference designator side of placement, X,Y location, and angle

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Source data provides intelligent data, net names, etc. These can be helpful in sorting out component placement, orientation anomalies, and moving the design through the placement CAM setup process quickly.

questions.question: Panelization tip — leave about ≥0.020 in clearance from board edge to copper to allow:
options: Better Wi-Fi antenna gain exclusively.
Singulation via v-score or tab-route without damaging copper.
Thicker soldermask dams under every BGA.
Skipping stencil design entirely.
questions.explanation: clearance between the PCB edge and any copper

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Depending on the design of the tab, this operation can leave a quite nasty burr on the board edge.

questions.question: Thru-hole components are often biased to the top side so that:
options: Wave solder can more easily access component pins.
The board fails ICT on purpose for training.
Bottom-side nozzles never have to move again.
Silkscreen white ink cures faster in sunlight.
questions.explanation: wave solder operation will have easy access to component pins

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFConsider the importance of biasing thru-hole components to the top side of the assembly so the wave solder operation will have easy access to component pins.

questions.question: Stencil artwork guidance in the chapter:
options: Provide 1:1 openings and let the stencil supplier coordinate compensation with the assembly ME.
Always oversize apertures 300% without talking to EMS.
Omit paste layers because operators will hand-solder BGAs.
Draw paste openings freehand on the fab drawing only.
questions.explanation: Provide 1:1 ratio openings on stencil artwork

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: A solder paste stencil artwork file is usually output in Gerber format from the source design layout and includes all the required openings to allow solder to be screened onto the SMT lands.

questions.question: Acceptance criteria leverage called out for PCBA:
options: IPC-A-610 as a comprehensive conformance guideline.
Only the fab’s Twitter poll results.
Whatever the night-shift operator prefers that evening.
No written criteria — “looks fine” is enough for flight hardware.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Adding a simple note: “Acceptance criteria per IPC-A-610,” says all the right things to your final inspection department.

questions.question: True or false: The assembly drawing is described more as an inspection document than a how-to document.
questions.explanation: less of a how-to document and more of an inspection document

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFConsider that the PCB assembly drawing is less of a how-to document and more of an inspection document.

questions.question: SpaceX ramp/rate preparation maps to this chapter when you:
options: Ship incomplete BOMs and hope EMS invents missing hardware lines.
Deliver complete assembly data and keep EMS communication tight through prototype → rate.
Skip XY data because “the pick-and-place will learn.”.
Treat panelization and stencil as optional until after launch.
questions.explanation: communicate often with the assembly supplier stakeholder

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: communicate often with the assembly supplier stakeholder
reference.lecture: Ensure suppliers are prepared to support prototype, ramp, and rate
